tonight.headline: Your D/ST slot is empty — add Washington today
body: Bad news first: the Bass claim went through with the Broncos D/ST as the drop, so AVIATO carry two kickers and no defence. ESPN projects 121.0 to Guillo-tinas' 88.9 as set, 67% to win.
Add the Commanders D/ST for Fairbairn now — a free agent, no waiver. Then Coker for Diggs before Thursday 18:15. That is about 131 projected.

case.label: The other side
case.body: Guillo-tinas start Kittle on a bye and bench Nacua (22.5) and Lamar Jackson (22.4), who is expected to play (FootballNation 26 Oct). Set properly they are about 120 — close to even with yours as set, behind it once the defence is added.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: The Commanders and Bengals both added elsewhere before you act — then the Browns D/ST (7.3, free) is the fallback.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Now — free agent, no waiver · before Sun 1 Nov 19:20 CDMX
doFirst.title: Add the Commanders D/ST, drop Ka'imi Fairbairn
doFirst.subtitle: Your D/ST slot is empty and projects zero. This morning's Bass claim went through with the Broncos D/ST as the drop, not Fairbairn — so AVIATO now carry two kickers and no defence.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Activity log 07:33Z: WAIVER_ADD Tyler Bass, WAIVER_DROP Broncos D/ST. Last night's card said drop Fairbairn. The lineup as set projects 120.9 with nothing in the D/ST slot.

case.label: The defence
case.body: Washington are 3.5-point favourites in a 40.5 total, off their bye (FootballNation 26 Oct). Philadelphia start rookie Tanner McKee — three sacks in his first start — with Hurts on IR and DeVonta Smith, Wicks and Barkley hurt (Fantasy Life 27 Oct).

case.label: The drop
case.body: Fairbairn (86.9% rostered) is on a Houston bye and Bass now kicks for AVIATO. Chem starts one kicker and kickers are streamed (STRATEGY §5) — the market values him, but a second kicker cannot score here. Not churn: the slot is empty, which the churn rule treats like a player ruled out.

case.label: Contested
case.body: Fantasy Life ranks the Bengals (home vs Tennessee, -10) above Washington. ESPN projects Commanders 7.9, Browns 7.3, Bengals 7.0 in Chem scoring. The projection sets it; the Bengals are the fallback if Washington are taken. Re-claiming the Broncos (on waivers to Thu 01:00 CDMX, 6.5) would reverse a move made hours ago and project lower.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The Bengals D/ST or Browns D/ST, both free this morning, outscores the Commanders D/ST by more than three points in Week 8 (archive).

case.label: The gap
case.body: 2.0 points — exactly on the coin-flip line; lineup_check.py labels it PROJECTION (its threshold is under 2.0). Either way the rule is the same: take the projection.

case.label: Coker

case.label: Diggs

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Diggs outscores Coker in Week 8 (archive), graded on the outcome. Also void it before kickoff if Wednesday's Panthers report lists Coker limited or out.

whatWentWrong.lead: JuiceJam 105.22, AVIATO 89.76 (archive). Kamara's 13.2 sat while Metcalf scored 7.6 in the flex.

case.body: Nothing about the method — one loss on a real projection gap is variance. Set the projection lineup: Coker over Diggs.
